import numpy as np

# NASA outlays in millions from the tables
nasa_outlays = {
    2008: 17834,

    2016: 18828,
    2017: 18698
}

# Convert to billions
values = [v/1000 for v in nasa_outlays.values()]
print("NASA Outlays (billions) for FY 2008-2017:")
for year, val in zip(nasa_outlays.keys(), values):
    print(f"  {year}: {val:.3f}")

# Sort values
sorted_values = sorted(values)
print(f"\nSorted values: {sorted_values}")

# 10% Winsorization for 10 data points
# 10% of 10 = 1, so we replace the smallest 1 and largest 1 values

# Get the sorted values
from scipy import stats
winsorized = stats.mstats.winsorize(values, limits=[0.1, 0.1])
print(f"\nWinsorized values: {winsorized}")

# Calculate the range (max - min) after Winsorization
winsorized_range = winsorized.max() - winsorized.min()
print(f"\n10% Winsorized range: {winsorized_range:.4f} billions")
print(f"Rounded to hundredths: {winsorized_range:.2f}")

# Also verify manually
print("\n--- Manual calculation ---")
sorted_v = sorted(values)
print(f"Sorted: {sorted_v}")
print(f"Min: {sorted_v[0]}, Max: {sorted_v[-1]}")
# Replace min with 2nd smallest, max with 2nd largest
winsorized_manual = sorted_v.copy()
winsorized_manual[0] = sorted_v[1]  # Replace smallest with 2nd smallest
winsorized_manual[-1] = sorted_v[-2]  # Replace largest with 2nd largest
print(f"After winsorization: {winsorized_manual}")
print(f"Min: {min(winsorized_manual)}, Max: {max(winsorized_manual)}")
print(f"Range: {max(winsorized_manual) - min(winsorized_manual):.4f}")
EOF
